records.title: Visual Autoregressive Modeling: Scalable Image Generation via Next-Scale Prediction

evaluation.identityEvidence: Official title matches arXiv title; author and abstract record checked on the current arXiv page.

aiDevelopmentContribution.specificChangeToAi: Recasts visual autoregressive generation from raster-order next-token prediction to coarse-to-fine next-scale prediction.
aiDevelopmentContribution.externalAssessment: The official committee groups the winners as highly impactful and ground-breaking, identifies VAR as an innovative visual autoregressive model, and highlights its generation quality, efficiency and scaling evidence.
aiDevelopmentContribution.limits: Committee and paper evidence concern the evaluated image-generation setting; do not claim universal superiority over diffusion models.

records.title: Guiding a Diffusion Model with a Bad Version of Itself

evaluation.identityEvidence: Official title matches arXiv title; author and abstract record checked on the current arXiv page.

aiDevelopmentContribution.specificChangeToAi: Introduces autoguidance, replacing classifier-free guidance's unconditional term with a weaker version of the same diffusion model.
aiDevelopmentContribution.externalAssessment: The official committee groups the winners as highly impactful and ground-breaking and specifically identifies the replacement of widely used classifier-free guidance plus notable diversity and image-quality improvements.
aiDevelopmentContribution.limits: Evidence is strongest for the evaluated image-generation diffusion models; it does not establish universal gains for every modality or model.
